topic: A founder's guide to showing up online consistently when you're short on time
caption:
Ever feel like you're playing catch-up with your online presence? You know showing up consistently matters, but with a lean team, time is always the enemy. It's a common challenge for founders like you!

The good news? AI tools aren't just for big corporations. They can be your secret weapon for maintaining a steady flow of content. Think about using AI to brainstorm ideas, draft initial social media posts, or even repurpose existing long-form content into bite-sized pieces. This frees up your precious time to focus on strategy and engaging with your audience.

Don't let a tight schedule stop you from connecting with your customers. Even a small step with AI can make a huge difference in your consistency. What's one area where AI could help your team show up more consistently this week? ✨
headline: Be Consistent Online, Even Busy
